basis: DangoUI describes itself as a Vue 3 mobile component library for Web and uni-app.
The published dist/index.mjs is built with __WEB__=true and __UNI_PLATFORM__='h5'.
The three target components render standard Vue elements and expose Vue emits.
notProven: Taro H5 compilation of the published Vue render functions

basis: DangoUI quick-start says mini-program usage requires vite-plugin-dangoui.
vite-plugin-dangoui README says it is currently only for uni-app mini-programs.
The host is Taro, not uni-app, and its Vite config has no DangoUI plugin integration.
The published library bundle bakes Web branches into dist/index.mjs, including Textarea reading e.target before e.detail.
Source templates use div, span, img, button, input and textarea rather than @tarojs/components primitives.
requiredProofBeforeAnyMpClaim: documented or source-backed Taro integration path
real-device/devtools render of all three components
input and textarea update events carry correct values
button click fires exactly once and respects disabled/loading
component wrapper nodes do not break sheet layout

existing.handlerContract: onPublishNameInput(e) delegates to limitInputValue(e, publishName, 15, toast, publishNameInputKey); it expects e.detail.value and returns the truncated string
existing.overflowBehavior: truncate, increment key to remount, and show a throttled toast

relevantProps.disabled: boolean; default false; forwarded to native input

preservingAdapter.recommendedBinding: :value="publishName" placeholder="给卡组起个名字" :maxlength="-1" bordered ext-class="sheet-input sheet-input--du" @input="onDangoPublishNameInput"
preservingAdapter.whyNotDirectExistingHandler: DuInput emits a string for input, while the existing handler reads e.detail.value.
preservingAdapter.whyNotVModelForParity: v-model:value with maxlength=15 is simpler but bypasses the existing over-limit toast/remount path because the native maxlength normally prevents an over-limit value. Use it only if that behavior is intentionally relaxed and separately approved.
preservingAdapter.key: publishNameInputKey may remain on the component to preserve the current forced-remount behavior after custom truncation.
preservingAdapter.styleOwnership: Use DangoUI bordered as the single visible boundary; remove/neutralize the old .sheet-input border/background/padding on the wrapper class to avoid a double border. Exact scoped CSS requires rendered DOM verification.

unsupportedOrUnknown: No documented error/status prop on DuInput.
No validation-message rendering is built into this component alone.
Web programmatic focus is explicitly marked TODO in source; autofocus/focus behavior must be tested rather than assumed.

existing.placeholder: 一句话介绍玩法 / 上分思路
existing.handlerContract: onPublishDescInput(e) delegates to limitInputValue(e, publishDesc, 1000, toast, publishDescInputKey); it expects e.detail.value
existing.overflowBehavior: truncate, increment key to remount, and show a throttled toast

preservingAdapter.recommendedBinding: :value="publishDesc" placeholder="一句话介绍玩法 / 上分思路" :maxlength="-1" :show-count="false" bordered ext-class="sheet-area sheet-area--du" @update:value="onDangoPublishDescValue"
preservingAdapter.whyNotDirectExistingHandler: DuTextarea does not emit input; update:value carries a string, while the existing handler expects e.detail.value.
preservingAdapter.whyNotVModelForParity: v-model:value with maxlength=1000 would enforce the length but would not preserve the current overflow toast/remount semantics.
preservingAdapter.key: publishDescInputKey may remain on the component for the current forced-remount behavior.
preservingAdapter.styleOwnership: Use DangoUI bordered as the only field boundary. Its default bordered component is 150px tall, whereas the host textarea is 72px; a scoped extStyle/extClass height override and keyboard/scroll proof are required.

unsupportedOrUnknown: Disabled textarea state cannot be mapped to a verified DuTextarea prop in 3.6.16.
The component only emits update:value and has platform-conditional event extraction; the published Web-built bundle's behavior in Taro weapp is unverified.
No built-in action-bar avoidance or keyboard-safe scrolling API exists on DuTextarea. The sheet remains responsible for visibility.

existing.handlerContract: saveDraftFromSheet() calls onSaveDraft(), then closeSheet(); onSaveDraft persists, tracks success/failure, and shows toast

relevantProps.type: primary | secondary | outline | text; default primary
relevantProps.size: mini | small | normal | medium | large; default normal
relevantProps.text: string; default empty; default slot is also supported
relevantProps.icon: registered icon name, internal icon object, or image URL string

nativeBehavior.keyboardH5: native button activation should produce click, but must be verified through Taro H5
nativeBehavior.clickGate: component emits click only when !disabled && !loading and press is false
nativeBehavior.disabledAttribute: NOT FORWARDED; disabled/loading are internal emission gates and CSS classes, not a native :disabled attribute
nativeBehavior.htmlType: NOT EXPOSED; no type=button prop is rendered
nativeBehavior.tapEvent: NOT EXPOSED; consumer API is click

preservingAdapter.recommendedBinding: <DuButton type="secondary" color="primary" size="large" full ext-class="sheet-draft sheet-draft--du" :disabled="false" :loading="false" @click="saveDraftFromSheet">...</DuButton>
preservingAdapter.handler: saveDraftFromSheet can be bound directly because it ignores the emitted click event.
preservingAdapter.keyboard: Remove the host's manual keydown handlers only after native H5 Enter/Space activation is proven; DuButton itself exposes no keydown emit.
preservingAdapter.icon: Prefer preserving the current slot image initially. The icon prop accepts a URL string, but the source decides between registered icon and ; either path still needs rendered proof.
preservingAdapter.styleOwnership: DangoUI owns the button hit target, focus and disabled/loading classes. Host extClass may translate the approved One Piece geometry/colors, but must not recreate a second nested button surface.

unsupportedOrUnknown: No verified native disabled attribute or aria-disabled output.
No html button type prop; inside an HTML form the default submit behavior is a risk, although this current sheet is not a form.
No documented Taro weapp openType/event compatibility.
No current host loading/disabled state exists, so those states require experiment-only controlled probes without changing business outcomes.
